Seras Victoria is one of the main protagonists in the Hellsing series. Seras is a young police officer who was turned into a vampire by Alucard to save her from a would-be fatal gunshot wound in the chest, that he also caused.

After turning into Alucard's fledgling vampire, Seras becomes a member of the Hellsing Organization and helps them protecting England from evil vampires. She is very loyal to her master and to Integra Hellsing, the leader of Hellsing. Despite being a vampire, she keeps her humanity, being innocent, kind-hearted and reluctant to drink blood. Seras only gives in to her desire of consuming blood when seeking revenge for the death of the man she loves, Captain Pip Bernadotte, who is brutally murdered while saving her from Zorin Blitz. By drinking Pip's blood, Seras absorbs his soul (turning him into her familiar) and finally becomes a true vampire.

She is voiced by Fumiko Orikasa in the Japanese version of the anime, and by Katherine T. Gray in the English version of the anime.
